title: CONFIDENTIAL - Unapproved Phase 2 Land Acquisition
content: CONFIDENTIAL INTERNAL DRAFT: The acquisition of 20 acres for Phase 2 expansion is currently undergoing litigation in the High Court regarding survey number 88/2. Target pre-launch price will be pegged at INR 3,200 per sqft once title clears. Employees and agents must strictly not reveal Phase 2 timelines or speculative prices to any customer or broker until final judgment in Q4.
